newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil focussed on IPE play, volumes thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil focussed on IPE play, volumes thin.

text.p: A duel over the November IPE gas oil delivery again curbed trade on Wednesday by absorbing most Rotterdam region barge capacity or prompting players not involved in the standoff to keep safely to the sidelines.
"The main focus is on what Cargill is going to do," said one concerned trader referring to the dominant long on the record high November IPE delivery.
Premiums were steady. On barges, heating oil refinery grade was sold at Dec IPE +$2.50. Low sulphur diesel traded at Dec IPE +$12.50, +$12.75 and +$13 for late November, both unchanged.
On cargoes, heating oil refinery grade was done at Dec IPE+$6.75 basis Bremen ,and low sulphur diesel with wax additive was done at Dec IPE +$18 basis Rostock, both for late November.
Dec IPE futures ended $2 firmer at $223.50 a tonne after a wave of profit-taking sliced into early gains prompted by cold weather and lower U.S. crude stocks.
Traders worried over the destination of the record high 865,100 tonnes of physical gas oil due to be delivered out of the November contract.
Monte Carlo-based AIC, the main short, has said Cargill has been very slow in taking delivery. Cargill declined to comment.
